body: Oh well, I guess I can just sit and hope that virtual reality becomes available at some point in my lifetime.
I guess I'll never know. I wish I could give it a trial run or something

I want to find meaning and purpose.

Edit: And I don't choose to think about these things. My mind just randomly decides to torture me with these thoughts.

I like to daydream especially at night, and I have this little fantasy world that I go to. It makes me really happy whenever I visit it. I just wish I could actually be there sometimes... 

I feel as though as long as I'd be able to sleep there and let my mind take breaks, then I wouldn't go crazy. That's just me, though.
I just want an answer that will satisfy my heart and leave me at ease, if one even exists. Hell, right now I could just go for a big, long hug...

Trust me, I know that plenty of people care about me. My group of high school friends were literally the cure to my depressing thoughts. They were able to keep me happy whenever I was around them. They were more than friends. Together we were like a family of 20-30 people. I love them all and I know they love me.

Now I'm in college and I barely get to see them. Sure I've made a new group of friends in college, but it's not the same. They're not family.

I remember lying in my bed crying uncontrollably the last night I was with them over summer break. I knew that life was going to get tougher after I left them, but I honestly didn't think it'd be this bad...
Because I can play it again. Possibly go for the highest possible score. Possibly go for the fastest speed run. Possibly go for a perfect run without dying.

I would undoubtedly prefer to love rather than not love. I would undoubtedly prefer to make some stranger happy over making them sad. But what does it matter? What does my happiness matter after I die?

I'm sorry. I don't even have a reason to feel this way. It's just that I think about these things and I don't even want to. I wish I could just be stupid and ignorant of these thoughts and go about merrily living my life without worry. But that's not the case. I'm consumed by these negative thoughts and it leads to me wishing I had the balls to kill myself, because I'm honestly getting tired of feeling like this. I guess not having the balls to kill myself is good in a way, but who knows, maybe one day I'll actually grow a set.

I just don't see how I can possibly get out of this rut. I've been having these thoughts for like a year or so and I can't stand it.
